user_message:
기존 D005 랑 지금 구조랑 뭐가 더 좋은 것 같아? 뭐가 더 나은 구조지?
4 반올림은 그냥 가상 임의의 반올림 하면 될 것갘아. 나머지 1,2,3,5,6은 a안으로 가자

decisions.1: Retain the common dictionary; preserve D005 source profiles; implement explicit mappings and report missing information without weakening the dictionary.
decisions.2: T10 is public competitor advertising; T11 is documents, announcements and events. Correct CQ17-3 wording through its revision sidecar.
decisions.3: Separate aspect sentiment, source text spans, ratings, sellers, samples and collection windows. Do not extrapolate to the market population.
decisions.4: Agent-selected synthetic policy SYNTHETIC-HALF-UP-1: exact decimal discount first, then round once to JPY/KRW 1 or USD 0.01, ties away from zero. Not an actual merchant policy.
decisions.5: Make necessary ontology corrections and rerun OOPS with the definition graph only; do not add arbitrary domain, range or inverse axioms to silence findings.
decisions.6: Actual provider pilot is a separate follow-up, one provider first. Actual provider mapping and actual data fitness remain not_run.
